measurementRules.rule: The reference is 1 m2 of the declared horizontal floor-area projection of complete closed cabinets at their unique first accepted release. HUB-3418 explicitly covers a complete corpus plus door and permits floor-area or front-area conversion from actual geometry. It is a Danish MFC/HDF/ABS product study, not a mango/rattan recipe or a native-provider equivalence. This method selects floor projection and does not substitute front area, total material surface, door sweep, packaging footprint or foot-contact area. Measure every actual complete cabinet separately in its declared closed configuration: only a verified rectangle uses measured overall width times overall depth; other shapes require measured actual projected geometry and a retained outline. Stacking cabinets never merges their individual areas. No EPD size, mass, lifetime, material percentage, impact result or factor is transferred. For each original cohort fix Q0 as the sum of the positive individual reference areas locked at first acceptance, with actual article ID, geometry, shape, state, BOM and event records. Closing accepted finished goods are already in Q0; dispatch, return, stacking, moisture change, repair and retest never create a second reference event. Keep an exhaustive disjoint original-acceptance-basis bridge across net remaining deliveries, all on-site accepted states, irreversible losses and other terminal dispositions. Record later dimensional and mass/moisture changes independently; do not restore lost water or material into survivors and also record the loss. Q0 is an event account, not another physical output. For a zero or unknown basis retain complete raw loads and unresolved unit results.

Independently weigh actual complete wet physical flows and nested moisture; provider-attributed model service and raw gross disclosure are separate ledgers. No catalogue mass or physical shrinkage by allocation.

The actual electricity identity is Alternating current, less than 1 kV, consumption mix to user, grid-average supply. Its exact native reference property is Net calorific value, not a newly invented generic Energy or a fuel premise. Metered kWh times 3.6 expresses the same electrical quantity in MJ for that native chain. Match the actual delivered voltage/geography/year/provider and account for all dedicated/shared manufacturing, ventilation, lighting, water heating and standby demand once. A complete grid provider is not evidence of a particular tariff, renewable claim or site energy quantity.

Dust control captures are not emitted dust. Preserve chips, shavings, collected dust, substrate/retained-contamination composition, fugitive dust and actual outlet particulate mass as distinct quantities without double counting. Any filterable stack test covers only its stated sampling train and operating window; it does not establish total fugitive, condensable or other unmeasured material. Waterborne finish is not zero-VOC or zero-hazard. Actual coating/glue/wood/cleanup compounds, water phases and carbon origins require applicable validated identification/quantification and uncertainty; add each genuinely present elementary species as its own row. Total VOC, an SDS list or a mass-balance residual cannot invent a molecular species, natural-air composition or unmeasured zero. No control efficiency or emission factor is assumed.

Convert raw extensive units and establish actual A and original Q0 before calc_model. Raw G or Qt uses separate calc_raw only as physical disclosure. Zero/unknown Q0 remains unresolved; there is no second division.

calculationRules.rule: For each first accepted complete cabinet, a_i=W_i times D_i only for a verified rectangular closed projection measured in m; otherwise measured actual projected outline area. Q0=sum(a_i)>0, locked once at first acceptance; actual mass/moisture is independent.

A=opening inherited own foreground vectors + actual period loads - closing unfinished/unassigned vectors - evidenced transfers to independent cohorts/functions once. Already accepted closing FG is not deducted. Postrelease service uses its own attributable A_H and original Q0 over H. Failed/zero-output loads, treatment and losses remain; provider aggregate and expanded history are not added together.
calculationRules.output: attributable A and A_H in each actual extensive unit

calculationRules.rule: q=A/Q0 for manufacture and q_H=A_H/Q0 for original-cohort service: one division after unit conversion and supported attribution. Linked treatment demand uses separately evidenced compatible provider-service A, never each cohort recharged full Qt. Zero/unknown Q0 or unknown assignment leaves unit result unresolved.
calculationRules.output: q and q_H per m2 reference flow

calculationRules.rule: q_raw=G/Qanalysis reports the complete actual physical leg or Qt and names its disclosure cohort/study. G is never scaled by environmental service share or consumption stock-corrected. This separate raw ledger is not another modeled treatment demand. Preserve raw G even when no valid unit result exists.
calculationRules.output: physical disclosure per m2, separate from modeled q

calculationRules.applies_to: each whole physical material and packaging pool
calculationRules.rule: Reconcile measured opening plus all actual inward/retained increments against closing plus actual outward/emitted losses; define each repair/retained term disjoint from other same-side flows, never cancel opposite flow with stock. For a packaging article O+P+I+ER+actual disjoint increments=C+S+EO+W+actual disjoint departures. Whole wet waste includes nested substrate, residue and water once. Mass, water, elemental, molecular and phase accounts are distinct; do not fit multiple unknowns by one residual.

measurementRules.rule: 参考量为完整闭合柜在唯一首次合格放行时的声明水平占地投影1 m2。HUB-3418明确覆盖完整柜体加门，并允许按真实几何换算占地面积或前脸面积；它是丹麦MFC/HDF/ABS产品研究，不是芒果木藤编配方，也不证明原生provider等同。本方法选择占地投影，不得用前脸面积、材料总表面积、开门扫掠面积、包装占地或柜脚接触面积替代。逐件测量实际完整闭合配置；只有核实为矩形的投影才用实测总宽乘总深，其他形状必须测量真实投影并保留轮廓。叠放不合并各柜面积；不得迁移EPD尺寸、标重、寿命、材料百分比、影响结果或因子。 每个原始批次将首次验收锁定的逐件正参考面积之和固定为Q0，保留真实整件ID、几何、形状、状态、BOM及事件。期末已验收成品已计入Q0；发运、退回、叠放、水分变化、维修、复检都不产生第二次参考事件。在原始验收基准上建立互斥且穷尽的桥：净剩余交付、场内全部已验收状态、不可逆损失及其他终结处置。后续尺寸和质量水分变化独立记录；不得将流失水或材料恢复到幸存柜中，同时又记录该损失。Q0是事件账，不是又一个实物流出；分母为零或未知时保留全部原始负荷并使单位结果保持未解决。
独立称重实际完整湿实物流和嵌套水分，provider可归属模型服务与原始实物披露有别；不使用标重，不因分配缩减实物。

实际电力身份为交流电，低于1 kV、用户端消费组合和电网平均供电。其准确原生参考属性是Net calorific value（净热值, 低位热值），不得新造通用Energy属性，也不引入燃料假设。电表kWh乘3.6只是将同一电量用MJ表达以匹配该原生链。匹配真实交付电压、地域、年份和provider，对制造、通风、照明、水加热及待机的专用或共享用电只计一次。完整电网provider不是某种电价、可再生声明或场址能耗量的证据。

除尘捕集量不是粉尘排放量。木块、刨花、捕集粉尘、基底及滞留污染组成、逸散粉尘和真实出口颗粒质量必须分开，不能重复。任何可过滤烟道测试仅覆盖其声明采样装置和运行时窗，不证明总逸散、可凝结物或其他未测材料。水性涂料不等于零VOC或零危险。实际涂料、胶、木材及清洗物种、水相和碳来源均需适用且已验证的定性定量与不确定性；每种真实存在的基本物种须另有一行。总VOC、SDS清单或质量平衡残差不能虚构分子物种、天然空气组成或未测零值；不得假设控制效率或排放因子。

measurementRules.applies_to: 除固定参考输出外每项投入产出
measurementRules.rule: 原始广延单位换算并建立实际A和原Q0后才用calc_model；原G或Qt另用calc_raw仅作实物披露。零未知Q0保持未解决，不再除第二次。

calculationRules.rule: 每件首次验收整柜仅真实矩形闭合投影用m制实测a_i=W_i乘D_i，否则实测真实轮廓投影面积。Q0=sum(a_i)>0，首次验收锁定一次；真实质量水分独立。

calculationRules.applies_to: 全部制造及原批次服务
calculationRules.rule: A=自身期初继承前景向量+实际当期负荷-期末未完成未分配向量-有证据转交独立批次功能向量一次。期末已验收FG不扣除；放行后服务用自身可归属A_H和H内原Q0。失败零产出负荷、处理及损失保留；provider汇总与展开历史不叠加。
calculationRules.output: 按每项真实广延单位的可归属A和A_H

calculationRules.rule: 制造q=A/Q0，原批次服务q_H=A_H/Q0：单位换算和有依据归属后只除一次。关联处理需求用独立有据且单位相容provider服务A，不向每批全额重复Qt。Q0为零未知或归属未知时单位结果未解决。
q_raw=G/Qanalysis披露完整实际实物腿或Qt，并标明披露批次研究；G不乘环境服务份额，也不作消耗库存扣减。该独立实物账不是另一项模型处理需求，即使无有效单位结果也保留原G。
calculationRules.output: 每m2实物披露，独立于模型q

calculationRules.applies_to: 每种整实物材料及包装池
calculationRules.rule: 实测期初加全部真实流入和滞留增量，与期末加真实流出排放损失核对；每个修补滞留项与同侧其他流互斥，不能用库存抵销相反方向流。每种包装O+P+I+ER+实际互斥增量=C+S+EO+W+实际互斥流出。整湿废物包含基底、残料和水各一次。质量、水、元素、分子、相账有别，不用单一残差拟合多个未知。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 以有记录、适用且已验证方法测量独立鉴定的真实物种和相态，含采样现场实验室覆盖及质控；捕集量不等于排放量，不能由可过滤烟道测试推定覆盖逸散或可凝结物。使用前每种其他真实物种均增独立原子行。未知关键定性定量保持hold，不以承诺SOP通过。 Method18仅为其完整依赖和排除项内的有机源气依据；NIOSH6016仅为保留组合未完整评价及干扰限制的空气氨依据。真实浓度流量时间逸散覆盖必须匹配，两来源均不证明当前工厂基质已合格。 原始记录保持未除分母，汇总字段只声明最终报告基准；全部真实单位换算和归属在第8节单次商式之前完成。 本协议仅归属manufacture；共享设备或运输事件跨过程接口的实物只记录一次，另立原批次服务向量。

dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原始产品上下文；原生整件硬字段；真实BOM及交接

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 具体研究使用前须建立实际基质方法、当前批次配方、涂层木材相容性和不确定性；未来SOP、投影规则或检查通过不能闭合未知关键方法；普通provider、辅助身份和用量缺口另行披露。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 适用真实方法；完整供应商TDS/SDS及限制；现场实验室资格

dataQualityRequirements.applies_to: 各批次及完整实物路线
dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 要求唯一Q0事件、全部真实原料WIP成品库存、继承史、失败零产出负担、受污染整件Qt及一次完整匹配provider量；实物来源和可归属服务向量分开，归属互不重叠。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 事件库存转移及供应商账；因果服务证明；实物单位闭合

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 两语完整规范段、顺序限定项、字面表格单元、原子卡、协议十二字段、公式输入输出、质量证据和来源ID类型参考用途均须保留于投影；仅计数或Schema指纹不证明语义保留。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 字面类型完整单元审计；准确来源原件抽取及定位
